required_documents.name: Original National Identity Card (NIC)
required_documents.notes: Must be the smart card (12-digit NIC number)

required_documents.name: Medical Certificate from National Transport Medical Institution
required_documents.notes: Must be from NTMI — not any private hospital

required_documents.name: Current Learner Permit
required_documents.notes: Must be held for at least 3 months

required_documents.name: Recent Passport-Sized Photographs
required_documents.notes: Check current DMT specification for count

workflow_steps.title: Obtain a Learner Permit first
workflow_steps.description: You must hold a learner permit for at least 3 months before applying for the full licence. Visit your nearest DMT district office.

workflow_steps.title: Get Medical Certificate from NTMI
workflow_steps.description: Visit the National Transport Medical Institution (NTMI) for a medical fitness examination. This is ONLY accepted from NTMI — not any private hospital.

workflow_steps.title: Book appointment on DMT e-Services portal
workflow_steps.description: Visit https://eservices.motortraffic.gov.lk to book your appointment at your nearest DMT district office.

workflow_steps.title: Prepare all required documents
workflow_steps.description: Gather all documents listed in the checklist. Double-check each item before your appointment.

workflow_steps.title: Attend DMT district office on appointment date
workflow_steps.description: Bring all original documents and photocopies. Submit your application and pay the applicable fee at the cashier.

workflow_steps.title: Pass the written knowledge test
workflow_steps.description: A computer-based test on traffic rules and road signs will be conducted at the DMT office.

workflow_steps.title: Pass the practical driving test
workflow_steps.description: A DMT examiner will conduct the practical driving test at the DMT office grounds.

workflow_steps.title: Collect your driving licence
workflow_steps.description: Upon passing, your licence will be issued. Verify the processing time at your DMT office.

dl_renewal.name: Driving Licence Renewal
dl_renewal.renewal_window: Can be renewed 3 months before expiry or up to 1 year after expiry

required_documents.name: Medical Certificate from NTMI
required_documents.condition: Required if renewing after expiry or for certain age groups. Check with DMT.

workflow_steps.title: Book renewal appointment online
workflow_steps.description: Visit https://eservices.motortraffic.gov.lk and book a renewal appointment.

workflow_steps.title: Prepare renewal documents
workflow_steps.description: Gather current licence + NIC. Check if a medical certificate is needed for your case.

workflow_steps.title: Visit DMT office on your appointment date
workflow_steps.description: Submit documents and pay the renewal fee.

workflow_steps.title: Collect renewed licence
workflow_steps.description: Renewed licence is typically issued on the same day.
